Make Sace usable through an FXML chat window with cross-platform JavaFX dependencies, a separate launcher, and tested interface-independent responses.

The first GUI version uses small text and only gives the bot a portrait. This makes conversations difficult to read on large displays and leaves user messages visually incomplete.

Increase the interface scale, display the supplied Jing and Consort Yu portraits, and give all user-facing responses a consistent battle-plan theme. Keep command guidance explicit so the themed wording does not reduce usability.

commitResults.messageTitle: Create the console UI only when needed
commitResults.messageBody:
Every Sace instance creates a console UI and Scanner even when the instance serves the JavaFX interface or a unit test. This couples the chatbot logic to a resource those callers never use.

Create the UI locally in run(), where console input is actually required. Keeping console resource ownership within the console workflow makes the shared chatbot logic simpler and avoids unnecessary Scanner instances.

commitResults.messageTitle: Harden command and storage error handling
commitResults.messageBody: Accept harmless command formatting differences, reject ambiguous parameters, validate event ranges, and roll back task changes when an atomic archive save cannot complete.
